metrics.name: Household main source of drinking water
metrics.construct: Distribution of households by the categorical variable labelled Main source of water. Derived piped-on-premises share uses categories 1 and 2 only; neighbour/public taps and all other sources remain separate categories.

category_values.2: Piped (tap) water on site or in yard

metrics.numerator_definition: For a derived piped-on-premises indicator only: weighted valid households with wat_drinkwat in {1,2}. Keep the full 16-category source distribution as the primary descriptive measure.
metrics.denominator_definition: Households with a valid response to wat_drinkwat; missing, invalid and unspecified codes must be distinguished after inspecting the actual data file.
metrics.variance_estimator: design_based_using_PSU_stratum_and_house_wgt; exact implementation and finite_population_correction pending questionnaire/technical documentation review

metrics.name: Frequency of insufficient food for adults in household
metrics.construct: Household-level categorical response labelled Insufficient food for adult. Preserve the full ordinal response; do not collapse to a binary food insecurity measure without a preregistered threshold.
metrics.population_scope: GHS 2025 target population; response code 6 indicates no adults in household and must not be treated as a substantive response
metrics.denominator_definition: For the ordinal distribution: households with substantive response codes 1-5; report code 6 as not applicable and code 9/missing separately. Do not silently drop or recode them.
metrics.variance_estimator: design_based_using_PSU_stratum_and_house_wgt; exact implementation pending questionnaire/technical documentation review

supplementary_variables.name: fsd_hung_child
supplementary_variables.label: Insufficient food for children
supplementary_variables.note: Code 6 means no children in household.

supplementary_variables.name: fsd_fewfoods
supplementary_variables.label: Lack of variety of food kinds

supplementary_variables.name: fsd_fewfoods_days
supplementary_variables.label: Lacked variety of food kinds for 5 or more days in the past 30 days

supplementary_variables.name: fsd_ateless_days
supplementary_variables.label: Ate less food for 5 or more days in the past 30 days

supplementary_variables.name: fsd_ranout_days
supplementary_variables.label: Ran out of food for 5 or more days in the past 30 days

metrics.name: Household main energy source for lighting
metrics.construct: Distribution of households by the categorical variable labelled Energy for lighting. Category 1 is electricity from mains; generator electricity is category 2 and must remain separate.

category_values.11: Other source of energy for lighting

metrics.numerator_definition: For a mains-electricity-for-lighting indicator only: valid households with eng_light == 1. Preserve code 2 (generator) and codes 9 and 10 as separate original categories pending source clarification.
metrics.denominator_definition: Households with a valid eng_light response; missing, invalid and unspecified responses must be separately classified from actual data.
metrics.variance_estimator: design_based_using_PSU_stratum_and_house_wgt; exact implementation pending questionnaire/technical documentation review

design_fields.note: Use F3 household-level fields for household estimates. The variable-level qstn fields are blank for these mapped variables; questionnaire wording and official derivation must still be checked. DDI summary frequency counts are not weighted estimates.
